theme_name: Hogwarts Pest Control: Cornish Pixie Panic
setting: Hogwarts castle ward-training chambers escalating into a castle-wide magical outbreak
tone: enchanted, urgent, readable, warm-to-stormy wizard-school fantasy

typography.primary_role: expressive magical headline font for title, buttons, reaction headers
typography.secondary_role: clean readable fantasy-supporting UI font for HUD and body copy
typography.copy_tone: short wizard-training commands, ward language, banishment verbs, castle crisis framing

shape_language.primary: arched panels, rune circles, wax-seal rounds, soft parchment cards
shape_language.corners: rounded with subtle pointed accents rather than toy-round capsules
shape_language.strokes: thin brass or spell-blue outlines with soft glow
shape_language.shadow_glow: low blur glow and candlelit depth, never neon arcade bloom

character_motifs.player_avatar: student spellkeeper represented by enchanted golden tongs
character_motifs.hazards: pixie-like magical pests with glowing wings and readable oval bodies
character_motifs.rewards: banishment sparks, rune motes, ward-restoration flares

item_motifs.tool: golden ward tongs with brass highlights
item_motifs.hud_icons: glyph badges, star sparks, ward crests
item_motifs.particles: gold sparks, blue sigils, emerald spores, patronus mist by progression tier

animation_motifs.ambient: slow candle drift, banner sway, spark float, fog bands
animation_motifs.reactive: brief ward flashes on danger, brighter banishment sparks on clears
animation_motifs.performance_rule: keep motion behind the playfield and away from draggable target silhouettes

hud_style.panel_treatment: spellbook glass panel with brass border and parchment text
hud_style.bar_treatment: gold-to-blue magic fill over dark ward trough

level_progression.name: Moving Staircase Rush
level_progression.motif: corridor lantern sweeps and staircase shadows

level_progression.name: Forbidden Forest Edge
level_progression.motif: moon fog and patronus-blue ward flashes

level_progression.name: Great Hall Night of 1,000 Charms
level_progression.motif: floating candles and converging house-color magic

mapping_rules.hot_magenta_to: ember crimson or ward stress tint
mapping_rules.bug_language_to: pixie, pest, curse, ward, banish vocabulary

dos: preserve drag readability and clear hit silhouettes
use magical framing through copy, color, and procedural motifs
keep HUD concise and mobile safe
do_not: do not change drag threshold, scoring, health semantics, or endless loop
do not overload the playfield with dense particles or low-contrast darkness
do not depend on franchise stills or local media assets for identity
safe_implementation_notes: world design should stay cosmetic and copy-level in this stage
five-level progression may be represented as conceptual world escalation rather than explicit game states
later stages can deepen audio and animated feedback using approved catalogs only
